text.p: * Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu confirmed he had become a member of the ruling Party of Social Democracy.

* Melescanu is expected to meet NATO Secretary General Javier Solana in Brussels. Melescanu will hand over President Ion Iliescu's message pleading for Romania's admission in the first wave of NATO enlargement.
* Melescanu is also expected to meet Belgian Foreign Minister Erik Derycke to deliever a similar message.
Melescanu said both meetings were part of Romania's extended efforts to persuade the Western defence alliance to consider it for a quick admission.
* Romania can play a very important role on NATO's east flank and the country's integration dialogue with the alliance is going on well, Solana told the Romanian state radio in Brussels.
* Romania will host NATO's Partnership for Peace first air drill next week. The drill is scheduled to take place near Bucharest's Otopeni international airport.
* Romania's Chief of Staff General Dumitru Cioflina will pay a two-day working visit to Spain starting October 14 to boost bilateral military ties.
* Opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) will prepare a special programme for the rectructuring of the mining sector, CDR leader Emil Constantinescu said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
